parsed.explanation: Parent national regime creates unavoidable traveller exposure: X-marker passport restrictions, entry-screening for document discrepancy with possible fraud ineligibility, federal facility bans, and documented abusive national custody, even though several orders are litigated. This state/province materially mitigates that for in-state life: 2014 public-accommodations nondiscrimination, gender-identity hate-crime penalties, 2018 court ruling for facilities by identity, and a 2024 sanctuary law, placing it among safest by recorded incidents. Those protections do not override national border/custody rules, and visitor coverage of the sanctuary law is unsourced. Two killings in ten weeks are a raw count without denominator/background rate, so not treated as a campaign. Net: protective operating regime above a hostile parent, but not low-risk overall.
